method: Git blob comparison and direct diff inspection of changed files; historical source anchors mapped to named functions, with function SHA-256 including trailing comments through the next function declaration. No engine executions, visual runs, new probes, or source mutations.

status_semantics.unchanged_critical_source: All enumerated critical sources are byte-identical. Historical finding logic retained; no fresh runtime closure.
status_semantics.changed_files_finding_logic_unchanged: One or more source files changed, but inspected diffs are unrelated to the finding; relevant algorithm remains.
status_semantics.fixed_by_static_inspection: Specific previously failing source predicate is corrected. Await parent-led execution before runtime closure.

context_changes.change: Windows release-package native loader added; do not generalize reference/Linux reruns to every native target.
Mac stock collision identity changed and expected proxy count 6092 -> 6139. This is a context admission change, not a demonstrated collision fix.
Exported builds can start in saved renderer mode using user://renderer.cfg override.template; editor/research path remains project renderer.

_at_ground fixes repeated lifting/drifting of old particle emitters across later events. This should be preserved; CR-AUD-05 concerns fixed-wing shared effect/ground datum, CR-AUD-20 concerns physical wall aftermath.
Owner/context files also changed; identical direct algorithms are not a claim that the whole launch/transitive environment is identical.
